blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A La Union high school has denied reports circulating online about an alleged shooting threat on its campus, saying its verification and investigation found no basis for the claim. In a Tuesday advisory, the administrators of Don Eulogio de Guzman Memorial National High School in the La Union town of Bauan said it immediately looked into the information after the rumor began circulating online. “Following the appropriate clarification and verification process, the school confirms that there is no truth to the reported shooting threat,” the administration said.
